visual.name: advanVisRosePie
visual.displayName: AdvanVis - Smart Rose, Pie and Donut
visual.description: Rose, pie and donut charts with locally calculated insights that explain your data in plain English. Free: every chart type, semicircle and gauge arcs, true-area rose, Top N with a working Other slice, highest and lowest highlighting, image slices, fx colours, drill-down, vector export and a basic headline. Pro (one-month free trial): the full smart headline and findings with How calculated, smart design tips, change against last period, and targets scored met or missed.
